---
title: Abuse-guard store
description: The short-lived state store behind rate limits, clearances and replay protection.
updatedAt: '2026-10-31'
---

The abuse-guard store keeps short-lived abuse-protection state, such as rate
limit counters, clearances and replay fences, in Cloudflare Durable Objects.

- Supabase remains the system of record. The store only holds losable state,
  and every entry expires.
- Each partition applies its commands atomically, so multi-step guards keep
  consistent results.
- Native Workers and hosted callers reach it through authenticated internal
  interfaces; it is not a public API.

Operational detail for these controls is maintained internally and is not published, because this repository is open source and published thresholds or rejection rules would help attackers.
